caption:
Content for your business is an evolution. Every video has to beat the last one.

Set a minimum you always deliver. If something new performs, it becomes the new base. If not, cut it.

Comment IDEAS and I'll send you 10 video ideas you can film this week.
why: It opens with Joseph's main claim that content is an evolution, then gives his base-and-build method in plain words. IDEAS fits because this is a content strategy teaching video.
